gen-dafont-quantum-gf-montagu-slab: Quantum spaces its letters loosely and keeps its mouths open, with not a single hairline stroke anywhere. Below, Montagu Slab keeps its thin strokes at a respectable weight.
gen-dafont-sf-wonder-comic-gf-esteban: Dense, tall words and half-finished bowls: that's SF Wonder Comic. Esteban then gently loosens the page up, its lowercase large against its capitals and its e never squeezed shut.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-hedvig-letters-se: Dreamy and spread wide, with huge gaps between letters. Starborn is best at floating those gaps, while Hedvig Letters Serif is best at sturdy, tall-bodied text with gentle pencil-soft contrast.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-marcellus-sc: Ethereal, with Starborn leaving wide, blank gaps between its letters. What stands out most is Marcellus SC, whose gently modulated lowercase still carries the stature of cast iron capitals.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-esteban: Stencilia tucks a tight gap between its ascender line and x-height, leaving spacious openings where its curves end. Esteban then relaxes into a lowercase that looks large beside its capitals.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-faustina: Structural, striking Stencilia leaves spacious gaps where curves end and keeps its ascenders tight to the x-height. Faustina adds a subtle pen-like softness to the bowls, with an open-jawed c.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-halant: Stencilia has spacious gaps where its curves end and a compact span from x-height up to the ascenders. Halant stands out for its towering x-height and outward-pointing terminals.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-headland-one: Spacious curve endings, tight ascenders: Stencilia is all structure. Beneath it, Headland One spaces its letters well apart, with gentle stroke variation and a tall rounded o nearly matching its capital.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-montagu-slab: Spacious gaps at every curve terminal make Stencilia unmistakable. Below, Montagu Slab brings robust downstrokes, slender turns and a sizable x-height, a softer contrast that never looks flat or stark.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-faustina: Nostalgic and digital, Visitor has gaping e mouths and short ascenders. Faustina steps in below with a tempered contrast that neither jolts nor flattens, its bowls thinning gracefully but not sharply.
